verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a payfac-as-a-service platform, so seller 1099-K tax reporting is an applicable axis. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions 1099-K threshold tracking, tax form generation, delivery, filing, or a corrections workflow. Onboarding SSN collection and data export are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, seller tax reporting is handled — 1099-K thresholds tracked, forms generated, delivered, and filed, with the data corrections workflow documented
